tokens.name: brand-ink
tokens.usage: OpenCode ink (opencode.ai --color-background-strong / --color-background, verified). Wordmark, splash, cover. Same in both contexts.

tokens.name: brand-ink-deep
tokens.usage: Tint base of opencode.ai hairlines (rgba(15,0,0,.12)). Not a UI fill.

tokens.name: brand-cream
tokens.usage: OpenCode cream (opencode.ai --color-background-strong / --color-background, verified). Never replace with #ffffff.

tokens.name: brand-gold
tokens.usage: Dark primary of both desktop themes 'opencode' and 'oc-2' (verified). Identity colour of live agent activity.

tokens.name: brand-terminal
tokens.usage: Neutral of the desktop app's 'opencode' theme (packages/ui/src/theme/themes/opencode.json, verified). Base of the session context.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page ground. Chrome = opencode.ai --color-background (light #fdfcfc, dark #131010). Session = desktop 'opencode' theme neutral #0a0a0a. Always opaque.

tokens.name: bg-panel
tokens.usage: Inputs, pressed/selected rows, code blocks, composer field. Chrome = opencode.ai --color-background-weak. Session #141414: secondary source, not in the desktop repo.

tokens.name: bg-raised
tokens.usage: Secondary controls, permission banner, sheet content, disabled fills. Chrome = opencode.ai --color-background-weak-hover. Session = desktop oc-2 surface-base.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Default 1px hairline; also the ghost-button border, as on opencode.ai. Chrome = opencode.ai --color-border-weak. Session = oc-2 border-weak-base.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs and keycaps that must be seen (≥3:1 on bg, bg-panel, bg-raised in every theme). Accessibility addition: opencode.ai --color-border (#d0cfce light, #4a4545 dark) is 1.5–2:1. Chrome-dark = site dark text-weak.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text and headings; ≥13:1 on every ground. Chrome = opencode.ai --color-text-strong.

tokens.name: text-body
tokens.usage: Body copy and long secondary text. Chrome = opencode.ai --color-text (the site's default body colour), ≥5.2:1 on all chrome grounds.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Metadata: timestamps, paths, model ids, line numbers. Chrome = site --color-text (same as text-body: the site's weaker step fails AA). Chrome-dark #9a9898 ≥5.3:1 (site dark text-weak #7f7a7a is 4.48:1). Session 5.0:1 on bg, 4.66:1 on bg-panel, 4.32:1 on bg-raised: never on session bg-raised.

tokens.name: text-weak
tokens.usage: Placeholders and disabled labels only — below 4.5:1 by design (opencode.ai --color-text-weak; session oc-2 text-weak). Never for information.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Primary action fill, one per view. Chrome = opencode.ai --color-background-strong (ink #201d1d light, #f2eded dark). Session = gold.

tokens.name: primary-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed primary. Chrome = opencode.ai --color-background-strong-hover (#302c2c light, #f8f6f6 dark). Session = oc-2 orange-500.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Label on primary. Chrome = opencode.ai --color-text-inverted. 16.3:1 in both chrome themes, 11.1:1 on gold.

tokens.name: agent
tokens.usage: Live agent activity as TEXT or glyph: ● running, streaming caret, active agent name. Chrome value = oc-2 orange-1000 because raw gold is 1.9:1 on cream (6.1:1 here). Session 11.1:1 on bg.

tokens.name: interactive
tokens.usage: Links and inline references only, never CTA fills. oc-2 text-accent (blue-600 light / blue-400 dark). ≥4.5:1 on all grounds.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px focus ring, solid, offset 2px. ≥4.5:1 on every ground in both contexts.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Completed, passing, valid. Session = oc-2 palette success. Chrome = oc-2 green-900 (green-800 fails on bg-raised). Always paired with ✓ or [+] and a word.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Attention, permissions, consequential operations. Session = oc-2 palette warning. Chrome = oc-2 yellow-1100 (legible on cream). Always paired with [!].

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Failure, Stop, Deny, destructive. Session = oc-2 palette error. Chrome = oc-2 red-800. Always paired with [x] and a word. Chrome-dark: 4.69:1 on bg-raised, ≥5.4:1 elsewhere.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Label on a danger fill (5.9:1 chrome, 6.1:1 session).

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Informational state, secondary technical emphasis. Session = oc-2 palette info. Chrome = oc-2 pink-900 (nearest ramp step to #a753ae that holds 4.5:1 on bg-raised).

tokens.name: diff-add
tokens.usage: Added-line text and the + gutter sign. Session = oc-2 state-fg-success. On diff-add-bg: chrome 5.0:1, session 7.3:1.

tokens.name: diff-add-bg
tokens.usage: Added-line row wash. oc-2 state-bg-success.

tokens.name: diff-del
tokens.usage: Deleted-line text and the − gutter sign. oc-2 state-fg-danger. On diff-del-bg: chrome 5.3:1, session 5.4:1.

tokens.name: diff-del-bg
tokens.usage: Deleted-line row wash. oc-2 state-bg-danger.

tokens.name: syntax-keyword
tokens.usage: Keywords and primitives (oc-2 pink-800 / pink-400).

tokens.name: syntax-string
tokens.usage: Strings (oc-2 green-800 / green-400). Chrome value is 4.3:1 on bg: code on chrome sits on bg only, never bg-raised.

tokens.name: syntax-property
tokens.usage: Properties (oc-2 orange-800 / orange-400). Chrome value 3.7:1: code on chrome is secondary; the session context is canonical for code.

tokens.name: syntax-type
tokens.usage: Types (oc-2 purple-800 / purple-400).

tokens.name: syntax-constant
tokens.usage: Constants and numbers (oc-2 syntax-constant).

tokens.name: syntax-critical
tokens.usage: Critical tokens, invalid code (oc-2 red-800 / red-400).

tokens.name: syntax-comment
tokens.usage: Comments (oc-2 text-muted: grey-700 / grey-500).

tokens.name: syntax-punctuation
tokens.usage: Punctuation and plain identifiers: same as text.

families.mono: "Berkeley Mono", "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Splash, onboarding, rare empty-state emphasis only.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Screen titles (opencode.ai heading: 22px / 700). One line, ellipsis.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Agent prose, user prompts, settings copy.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Transcript speaker labels (YOU / AGENT), group headers. Uppercase.

styles.name: tech
styles.usage: Tool-call rows, commands, paths, status lines.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Code blocks and diffs. Never below 13px.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Timestamps, model ids, branches, line numbers.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Tight inline relationships: glyph to label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Component internals: keycap padding, gap between buttons.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Related content: row vertical padding, gap inside a tool-call group.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen horizontal inset (phones); standard separation.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Screen inset on large phones and tablets.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Section separation.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Rare structural breaks.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Pages, lists, transcript, code, diffs, tool-call groups, app bar.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, keycaps, user prompt block, compact controls.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Text inputs.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Composer field. The maximum outside OS-owned sheets.

shadow.note: Depth is spacing, surface shift and hairlines. No shadows in application content.

tokens.name: shadow-none
tokens.usage: Every in-app surface. Android elevation 0.

tokens.name: hit-ios
tokens.usage: Minimum touch target on iOS (glyph may be smaller).

tokens.name: hit-android
tokens.usage: Minimum touch target on Android.

tokens.name: row-min
tokens.usage: Minimum list row height (ProjectRow, SessionRow).

tokens.name: row-max
tokens.usage: Maximum list row height with two lines.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Every divider and control border.

tokens.name: focus-width
tokens.usage: Focus ring width, offset 2px.
